name: Remove Password
label: Access
description: Save an unlocked copy of a PDF, Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file when you know its password.

name: Add PDF Page Numbers
label: Pages
description: Stamp page numbers onto a PDF, with a position and optional cover-page setting.

name: Merge PDF
label: Combine
description: Bring several PDFs together in the order you choose.

name: Watermark PDF
label: Annotate
description: Stamp text or an image across PDF pages.

name: Crop PDF
label: Pages
description: Hide content outside a selected page rectangle.

name: Edit PDF
label: Annotate
description: Add text, highlights, rectangle shapes, and notes to selected pages.

name: Protect PDF
label: Security
description: Add a password so only the people you choose can open it.

name: Protect Office Files
label: Security
description: Add a password to a DOCX or XLSX file and save a protected copy.

name: Images to PDF
label: Create
description: Turn photos and scans into one PDF, including HEIC images on supported systems.

name: PDF to Images
label: Export
description: Render pages to JPEG or PNG at 72, 150, or 300 dpi.

name: PDF to Text
label: Extract
description: Extract selectable text in page order into a .txt file. Scans need OCR.

name: Split PDF
label: Pages
description: Break one PDF into pages, ranges, or fixed-size chunks.

name: Extract Images
label: Extract
description: Pull embedded JPEG images out at their original resolution without recompression.

name: Sign PDF
label: Sign
description: Place a typed name or PNG or JPEG signature image on one or more pages. This is a visible mark, not a cryptographic signature.

name: OCR PDF
label: Unavailable
description: Unavailable in the current build. A local OCR adapter is required for scanned text.

name: Remove PDF Pages
label: Pages
description: Delete selected pages while keeping everything else in order.

name: Extract PDF Pages
label: Pages
description: Pull selected pages into a new PDF using ranges such as 1–3, 7.

name: Organize PDF
label: Organize
description: Reorder, rotate, and delete pages from a visual thumbnail grid.

name: Compress PDF
label: Optimize
description: Compress PDF stream data while preserving page geometry.

name: Convert Image Format
label: Convert
description: Convert between PNG, JPEG, WebP, and HEIC.

name: Compress Images
label: Optimize
description: Use a lossless copy mode or trade quality for a smaller encoded file.

name: Resize Images
label: Scale
description: Scale by pixels, percentage, or longest side while preserving aspect ratio.

name: Rotate and Flip Images
label: Transform
description: Rotate by right angles or flip horizontally or vertically.

name: Crop Images
label: Crop
description: Crop images to a selected aspect ratio or pixel rectangle.

name: Generate App Icons
label: Create
description: Generate PNG icon sets for macOS, favicon, iOS, and Android. macOS also gets ICNS.

name: Create GIF
label: Animate
description: Animate a batch of still images into a looped GIF.

name: Extract GIF Frames
label: Extract
description: Split an animated GIF into individual PNG frames.

name: Watermark Images
label: Annotate
description: Stamp text across a batch of images with an opacity setting.

name: Image Metadata
label: Privacy
description: Inspect metadata markers and save a re-encoded copy without them.

name: Colour and Tone
label: Adjust
description: Adjust brightness, saturation, and exposure in batches.

name: Split and Combine TIFF
label: TIFF
description: Split one multi-page TIFF, or combine multiple TIFF inputs.

name: Blur Faces
label: Unavailable
description: Unavailable in the current build. It needs a local face-blur adapter.

name: Remove Background
label: Unavailable
description: Unavailable in the current build. It needs a local background-removal adapter.
